name: AKATSUKI V

specs.notes: Output depends on market and year. US 2020: 335 hp and 365 lb-ft. US 2021 on: 382 hp @ 5800-6500 and 368 lb-ft @ 1800-5000 (used here). EU/UK and launch JDM: 340 PS (335 bhp, 250 kW) @ 5000-6500 and 500 Nm @ 1600-4500. Gear ratios, final drives, wheelbase and UK weights are from Toyota UK's official tech-spec PDF (Apr 2024); the US AT final drive of 3.15 matches. The 50:50 weight distribution and 2,470 mm wheelbase are from Toyota's global newsroom (2019 launch). If you use the EU power figure, pair it with the UK weight (1,495 kg DIN-style) for consistency.

garage.blurb: The modern turbo-six coupe: 382 hp from a 3.0 straight six, rear-drive, a short wheelbase and a perfect 50/50 balance. Quick to rotate, quick everywhere.

interior.notes: Detailed: dash with screens, leather/Alcantara seats, steering wheel. Right-hand drive (the model's). An automatic (the 8-speed): the hand stays on the wheel.
